data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: merge-to-main.sh consumes dso.workflow directly (RED phase)
- DD5: TDD RED phase

## What to Change
Modify `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh` to assert NEW behavior:
- fixture configs use `dso.workflow=ci-pr` instead of `merge.strategy=pr`
- fixture configs use `dso.workflow=local` instead of `merge.strategy=direct`
- Cross-strategy mismatch test uses `dso.workflow` values in state files
- `_write_config` helper writes `dso.workflow=<value>` instead of `merge.strategy=<value>`
- Error messages from the dispatcher reference `dso.workflow` not `merge.strategy`

The test functions to update:
- test_dispatcher_routes_to_direct_script: use dso.workflow=local fixture
- test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script: use dso.workflow=ci-pr fixture
- test_resume_rejects_cross_strategy: test that resume rejects when state file has dso.workflow=local but current config has dso.workflow=ci-pr

These tests MUST FAIL before Task 8 (merge-to-main.sh still reads merge.strategy).

## Test Approach (Given / When / Then)
- Given: dso-config.conf with `dso.workflow=ci-pr`, stub merge-to-main-pr.sh writes sentinel
- When: bash merge-to-main.sh
- Then: sentinel file exists (dispatcher routed to pr script)

## .test-index RED Marker Requirement
Update .test-index for `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main.sh`:
Add RED markers for updated test function names.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — suite overall with RED markers
  Verify: bash -c 'grep -q "\[test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script\]" .test-index && echo "RED marker present"'
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Dispatcher test uses dso.workflow fixture instead of merge.strategy
  Verify: grep -q 'dso.workflow' tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh
- [ ] Dispatcher test no longer uses merge.strategy in _write_config
  Verify: ! grep -q 'merge\.strategy' tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers for dispatcher test functions
  Verify: grep '\[test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script\]' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: UPDATE test: assert merge-to-main.sh dispatcher routes on dso.workflow instead of merge.strategy
